description: This Java class defines an abstract class TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider that measures and logs the duration of authentication processes within a security infrastructure. It provides mechanisms for timing, error handling, and converting errors into authentication results. The class is part of a larger security/authentication framework in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that measures the time taken to authenticate a request and manages timing and error handling logic for authentication processes.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Main method to authenticate a request, measuring time and handling success and failure cases asynchronously.

methods.name: getRootCause
methods.description: Utility method to extract the root cause from nested exceptions.

methods.name: isInternalError
methods.description: Checks if an HttpStatusCode indicates an internal error.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for identifying the request type.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Abstract method where the actual authentication logic should be implemented.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Abstract method to create a failed authentication result based on an error.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, unwrapping nested exceptions as needed.

methods.name: unwrapDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Recursive helper to unwrap a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, possibly setting headers.

methods.name: failOnTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a CompletableFuture with timeout logic, converting timeouts or errors into failure results.

methods.name: buildInternalErrorException
methods.description: Builds a specific internal error exception wrapping a cause and headers.
